analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of docs.medusajs.com covered 134 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. The site contains 4 confirmed broken internal documentation links requiring immediate repair. API reference coverage is critically low at 42.9% with only 38 API pages detected across the documentation. Freshness metadata is entirely absent with 0% of pages displaying last-updated timestamps. Example code reliability is strong at 94.83%, indicating solid technical content quality.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved at 100% (134 of 134 discovered pages)
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with strong link verification at 95%
Example code reliability estimated at 94.83%, demonstrating quality technical samples
Zero repository navigation broken links, indicating clean source control integration
Low SEO/geo issue rate at 0.19%, showing good search optimization fundamentals
risks: API reference coverage critically low at 42.9%, leaving majority of API surface undocumented
Only 38 API pages detected for a product with 134 total documentation pages (28% API density)
Zero freshness metadata across entire documentation set prevents users from assessing content currency
4 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrade user navigation experience
API confidence at 85% suggests potential gaps in API page detection or classification
Absence of last-updated timestamps creates trust issues for rapidly evolving product documentation
Low API coverage may force users to rely on source code inspection rather than official docs

prioritized_actions.action: Repair 4 confirmed broken internal documentation links to restore navigation integrity
Expand API reference documentation from 42.9% to minimum 80% coverage across all public APIs
Implement last-updated timestamps on all 134 pages to establish content freshness visibility
Audit API page detection methodology to confirm 38 pages represent complete API surface area
Establish automated link checking in CI/CD pipeline to prevent future broken link introduction

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical content, code examples, or API specifications against actual product behavior
API coverage calculation depends on automated detection patterns which may misclassify pages or miss non-standard API documentation formats
Broken link detection limited to crawled pages only; dynamic content, authenticated sections, or JavaScript-rendered links may be excluded
Example reliability is estimated through static analysis and cannot confirm runtime execution success or version compatibility
Freshness assessment relies on visible metadata only; actual content update frequency may differ from displayed timestamps
